activity_statements.statement: designs and manufactures passenger vehicles and trucks at North American assembly plants employing tens of thousands of production workers
operates Calty Design Research studios in Ann Arbor and Newport Beach to develop exterior/interior vehicle designs for production and concept vehicles
conducts North American R&D from Ann Arbor generating 2,667 USPTO patents in 2023, more than any other automaker for 10 consecutive years
sells vehicles through nearly 1,500 Toyota and Lexus dealerships across North America
provides vehicle financing, leasing, and protection plans through Toyota Financial Services to consumers and dealers across three customer service centers in the U.S.
globally spends approximately $1 million per hour on R&D to develop next-generation vehicles and advanced mobility concepts

name_reality_gap: none — Toyota is transparently an automotive manufacturer. The financial services arm and scale of R&D spending (~$1M/hour globally) are less visible from the brand name but do not constitute a hidden identity.
extraction_notes: North America operations page was highly informative. Global segment data (e.g., exact manufacturing plant count) not retrieved; 10-K not directly accessed. Financial services size estimated from page data about TFS (3,300 associates).
